summary.text: John Healy is the Republican candidate for the open New York State Senate District 13 seat in Queens.
A Queens native and President of the Sunnyside GOP Club, he ran for New York City Council District 26 in 2025 on the Republican and Conservative lines and lost to incumbent Julie Won.

paragraphs.text: Healy is a Queens native who, as of the New York Young Republican Club's March 2025 endorsement, served as President of the Sunnyside GOP Club.

In 2025 he ran for New York City Council District 26 in western Queens on the Republican and Conservative Party lines, and lost the November 4, 2025 general election to incumbent Julie Won, receiving 18.3% (7,498 votes) to her 81.4% (33,425 votes).
He is on the November 3, 2026 ballot as the Republican candidate for State Senate District 13; the June 23, 2026 Republican primary was canceled and he advanced without appearing on the ballot.
